fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { workloadScale: "Build a workload questionnaire for my warehouse staff. Use 4 statements on a 5-point agree scale, from Strongly disagree to Strongly agree. Two statements are negative, such as I skip breaks to keep up, so score those as 6 minus the answer. Add the 4 scores into a total out of 20 for each person, and show how many of my 240 staff have answered.", courseEvaluation: "Build an end-of-course evaluation for my college with 5 statements rated 1 to 5. For each course and statement, report the share of students who answer 4 or 5 instead of an average. When fewer than 6 in 10 students in a course agree with any statement, send the result to that department's chair.", classCheckIn: "Build a check-in for my fitness studio that members open on their phones after each class. Show 3 statements, one per screen, each on a 4-point agree scale with no middle option, plus a comment box. When anyone answers 1 or 2, email my studio manager with the class name and the comment.", beforeAndAfter: "Build a staff questionnaire with 6 statements on a 5-point agree scale that I run in March and again in September. For each statement, show the share of my 120 staff who agree or strongly agree in each round and the change in points, and post the results to my people team channel in Slack." };

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A member answers Disagree on a phone check-in after spin class, and her comment that it began 15 minutes late emails the studio manager, Marcus Hale.
